items.title: Table of contents for markdown panes
items.text: Markdown viewers with two or more headings get a native contents card that tracks the section you're reading and jumps you to any heading — in a left gutter on wide panes, a slide-in overlay on narrow ones.

items.title: Markdown reads like macOS content
items.text: Body text is now set in the system font (SF Pro) and code in SF Mono, instead of GitHub's web font stack.

items.title: Viewer panes browse like a browser
items.text: Every viewer, files included, has an editable address bar plus back / forward / reload / home. Type a URL to go to the web or a path to point back at a file; Home and history survive a session restore.

items.title: IPC commands hit the right app
items.text: Each pane knows the socket of the app instance that owns it, so `ghoztty +split` run inside a debug-build pane splits the debug window instead of the release app.

items.title: Hero mode follows the live layout
items.text: Splits created or closed after entering hero mode are now reachable, and a single keystroke moves only the window you're aiming at.
`+split --target=<window>` now works with a viewer focused (it used to exit 0 and do nothing).
`--color=random` windows stay dark but now lift off pure black, so the hue actually reads.
